name: Phantom X
description: A director-led AI studio based in Los Angeles.
descriptionMore: Founded, by its own account, by industry veterans with backgrounds in advertising production, game cinematics, and technology innovation. Positions itself as a studio that "builds films, not demos," guided by the principles Craft Over Gimmick, Director-Led, and Speed Without Sacrifice. Releases both original IP (The Chronicles of Bone, Echo Hunter, Exile Protocol, Red Rainbow, Metamorphosis, The Sage, Last Recall) and commercial work for brands — Nike, Porsche, Booking.com, Sixt, Premier League, WTA Finals Riyadh, Kalshi, and others. The studio's directing roster includes Kavan the Kid, Mike J Mitch, S.A.V, Rafa, and Aze Alter. The studio has been covered by Forbes, The Guardian, Los Angeles Times, Deadline, and TechRadar.
